product_metadata.title: iDesign York Lyra Steel Free-Standing Hand Towel Holder - 6" x 9" x 13.5", Pearl White
features: COUNTERTOP HAND TOWEL HOLDER: Provides convenient storage and access to two small hand towels next to the sink
FREE-STANDING DESIGN: Free-standing design and raised base keep items clean, dry, and off the counter
VERSATILE STORAGE SOLUTION: Can also be used to store and display necklaces, earrings, bracelets, rings, and more
MADE WITH DURABLE STEEL: Durable steel construction with pearl white finish stands up to every day use and matches a variety of decor styles
COMPACT SIZE: Measures 6.2" x 7.6" x 13.8" and is ideal for use in compact spaces on countertops
description: Organize your bathroom in style with the iDesign York Lyra Hand Towel Holder. This countertop organizer provides convenient storage and access to two small hand towels next to the sink. The free-standing design and raised base keep towels clean, dry, and off the counter until ready for use. This versatile organizer can also be used to store and display necklaces, earrings, bracelets, rings, and more. The durable steel construction with pearl white finish stands up to every day use and matches a variety of decor styles. Measuring 6" x 9" x 13.5", this bathroom organizer is ideal for use in compact spaces on countertops. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
